runtime: Real local Firebase Auth/Firestore emulators + real Next dev server + Chromium; no mocked API/auth/database
checks: real password sign-in and ID token verification
manual form including bundled picture choice
recent-auth prompt retains unsaved edits and uses real reauthentication
later draft edit preserves published snapshot
cross-practice reads, list, create, update and publish denied
concurrent saves yield one success and one conflict
direct Firestore read denied by emulator rules
suspension denies old token and clears workspace
limitations: Local emulators do not verify production IAM, deployed Firebase rules or live backend configuration.
